QuestInfo.name: Monstrous Rumors
QuestInfo.0: Strange rumors are circulating around the Monster Park. Talk to Mary at the Monster Park and see what you can find out.
QuestInfo.1: Mary was a dead end. Go talk to Spiegelmann about the secret vault.
QuestInfo.2: Spiegelmann said he didn't know anything, but he was acting strange. It might be time for a thorough investigation of the Monster Park.

0.0: Welcome to Monster Park! Which ticket would you like today? \r\n#L0##bI'm not here to exchange tickets. I'm here to investigate a rumor I heard about Monster Park...#l\n#k
0.1: Oh? Do you mean the one about the Mysterious Treasure Vault? \r\n#L0##bUm, sure. I mean, precisely! Tell me more, specifically the part about 'treasure.'#l\n#k
0.2: There's not much to tell. The vault is supposedly full of gold and other valuables. \r\n#L0##bYes, yes, but how does one GET there?#l\n#k
0.3: How would I know? It's just a rumor, remember? If you want more info, why don't you talk to Spiegelmann? It's HIS park, after all.

yes.0: If Spiegelmann spills the beans, you'd better fill me in! I want to know, too!

no.0: Whatever you want. It's just a silly rumor anyway.

1.0: Welcome to Monster Park, a place of adventure, mystery, and marv--\r\n#L0##bYeah, yeah. Now tell me about the Mysterious Treasure Vault in Monster Park!#l\n#k
1.1: T-treasure vault! I have n-no idea what you're referring to! I'm busy helping other patrons, so just run along. RUN ALONG!\r\n#L0##bI think I'll just search for it myself, then.#l\n#k
1.2: W-wait! I mean, you won't find it. I mean, there's nothing there! Now, and this is completely unrelated, but if you happen to stumble across, say, a vault door, DO NOT OPEN IT. There are, uh, ravenous lions trapped inside. \r\n#L0##bSuuuuuure there are.#l\n#k
1.3: If there's nothing else, I'm busy. Shoo.

yes.0: There is NO treasure vault. Now, if you have nothing IMPORTANT to talk about, I'm busy.

npc.0: You still haven't talked to Spiegelmann about the rumor? Do it already! He's at the Monster Park entrance.
